## Land Surface Temperature

```{r}
#| label: setup-lst
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/lst/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: lst-data
#| output: false
summer_file <- list.files(tabular_dir, pattern = "summer_area\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(summer_file) > 0) {
  ojs_define(summer_area = read.csv(summer_file[1]))
  ojs_define(lst_city = city)
} else {
  ojs_define(summer_area = NULL)
  ojs_define(lst_city = city)
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: lst-plot
//| output: true
import { plot_summer_area, setCity, setWidth } from "../core/ojs/plots.js"

setCity(lst_city)
setWidth(640)

summer_area ? plot_summer_area(summer_area, {height: 350}) : html`<p><strong>No LST data available</strong></p>`
```
